The Supreme Court on Friday dismissed Tamil Nadu’s plea seeking directions to Karnataka to release additional Cauvery water to meet an alleged shortfall in inflow. A bench of Justices Vikram Nath and Aparesh Singh rejected the two applications, which urged it to direct 11 TMC of additional river water.
